title: Event Times and Time-Varying Markers
text: Inside sim_effect() expression, event_time(proc, k) time process proc’s k-th event, 0 hasn’t happened yet. negative k counts back latest event: event_time(visit, -1) latest visit event_time(visit, -3) third latest. Combined current time t, gives effects time since event: t - event_time(operation, 1) time since first operation. Since event_time() 0 event, t - event_time(operation, 1) just t someone yet operated. Multiplying event count, operation * f(t - event_time(operation, 1)), can used effect event happened. Suppose patients may undergo operation, raises death hazard immediately , gradually fades . example look like : \lambda_{\text{death}}(t)   = \lambda_0(t) \exp\left( 3 \cdot \text{operation}(t) \cdot e^{-2(t-T_{\text{operation},1})} \right). baseline hazards constant (\nu = 1), \lambda_0(t) = 0.02. operation, measured time since operation, u = t - T_{\text{operation},1}, death hazard therefore h(u) = 0.02 \exp\left( 3 e^{-2u} \right). Right operation hazard h(0) = 0.02 e^3 \approx 0.40, 20 times baseline. time passes, e^{-2u} goes 0 hazard returns baseline 0.02. Two time units operation, 6% baseline. check simulation, follow operated patient operation death censoring. Nelson–Aalen estimator estimates cumulative death hazard since operation, (substituting w = 3 e^{-2v}, dv = -dw / (2w)) \begin{aligned}     H(u) & = \int_0^u h(v) \, dv     = 0.02 \int_{3 e^{-2u}}^{3} \frac{e^w}{2w} \, dw \\          & = 0.01 \left[ \operatorname{Ei}(3) - \operatorname{Ei}\left( 3 e^{-2u} \right) \right],   \end{aligned} \operatorname{Ei}(x) = \int_{-\infty}^x e^w / w \, dw exponential integral. Censoring end follow-don’t depend time since operation, estimate unbiased. , H(u) computed numerical integration.  shapes follow pattern. expression times coef added log-hazard, example:
